title: How 100 Million People Survive Between the Nile and Desert
description:
Discover what everyday life looks like in modern Egypt beyond the famous tourist monuments and ancient pyramids. Learn how more than 100 million people manage to live, work, and build communities in a narrow river valley surrounded by massive desert landscapes.

Explore the hidden realities of Cairo traffic, traditional farming along the Nile, Red Sea coastlines, and the economic challenges of supporting a rapidly growing population in an extreme environment.

#egypt #nile #documentary #cairo #everydaylife
